Are you ready to help shape the future of hearing care? In this role, you will identify emerging technologies and turn promising opportunities into mature concepts that can inform GN Hearing’s future solutions.

In the role of Incubation & Technology Scouting Lead in the GN Hearing R&D organization, you will connect external technology intelligence with GN Hearing’s internal capabilities to mature early opportunities into validated concepts, prototypes and well-framed development initiatives.

The Team you will be part of:

You will join GN Hearing’s R&D organization, where we develop advanced hearing solutions that support people with hearing loss in everyday life. Our work brings together expertise across audiology, acoustics, electronics, mechanics, embedded software, algorithms, fitting solutions and digital services.

You will work across a broad network of technical specialists, product teams and external partners. We are curious, collaborative and practical in our approach, combining exploration with a clear focus on bringing meaningful innovations closer to product development.

Your contribution is appreciated, and you will:

• Scout and assess technology opportunities by monitoring emerging technologies, companies, suppliers, research and ecosystem developments relevant to GN Hearing’s technology and product strategy.

• Build actionable technology intelligence by maintaining the opportunity roadmap, knowledge base and internal expert network, and translating internal and external signals into recommendations for R&D leadership, product management and innovation teams.

• Evaluate and mature external opportunities through early technical dialogue, partner assessments and due diligence, with appropriate consideration for confidentiality, intellectual property, data and regulatory requirements.

• Turn opportunities into development-ready concepts by leading feasibility work, proof of concepts and early prototypes, and aligning cross-functional experts around system vision, interfaces, performance targets, risks and key assumptions.

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

• You bring an advanced degree in a related technical field.

• You may have experience in advanced R&D, hearing technology, medical-device development, systems engineering, innovation or technical product incubation.

• You bring deep technical knowledge into one or more relevant domains, such as acoustics, audiological algorithms, low-power electronics, embedded systems, connectivity, sensors, mechanical design, fitting systems, mobile software or AI and machine learning.

• You have experience moving early technology or product ideas from exploration through concept definition and proof of concept towards product development, including complex systems spanning devices, software and digital services.

• You communicate clearly, make sound recommendations with incomplete information and work well with technical and business stakeholders across the organization.

We pride ourselves on encouraging flexible work whenever possible. We trust our people to fulfill their responsibilities, to know when in-person collaboration is better than hybrid, and to be present when it's needed most.

We encourage you to apply

Even if you do not match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting the invitation to the interview.

How to apply?

Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than November 30. Applications are assessed continuously, so do not wait to send yours.

Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV, including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying.

Join us in bringing people closer

GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss to overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, and provide great experiences for audio and gaming users.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

**We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

Help shape educational programs that improve outcomes for newborns and children worldwide

At Laerdal Medical, our mission is simple: helping save lives. As Product Manager for the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) Programs, you will shape and grow educational offerings that support neonatal and pediatric care, including Resuscitation of Quality Improvement (RQI) for Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) (RQI for NRP) and courses delivered through the PediaSkills Learning Platform.

You will own assigned programs across the full product lifecycle, from insight and ideation through development, launch, continuous improvement, and growth. Working closely with colleagues across Laerdal, the AAP, and Resuscitation Quality Improvement Partners (RQI-P), you will translate customer, learner, partner, and business needs into clear priorities and successful product outcomes.

This is a unique opportunity for someone who enjoys combining strategy, collaboration, and hands-on execution, while contributing to programs with meaningful impact.

What you will do

• Lead and communicate a clear product vision, strategy, and roadmap for assigned AAP programs and educational offerings.

• Own the full product lifecycle, from discovery and prioritization through development, launch, optimization, and ongoing performance.

• Translate customer, learner, instructor, partner, and business needs into clear product priorities, requirements, and measurable outcomes.

• Define and prioritize features and enhancements based on customer insights, optimization opportunities, the competitive landscape, and business goals.

• Collaborate with development, marketing, commercial, customer-facing, and partner teams to deliver high-quality product capabilities on time.

• Manage scope, schedule, resource, and priority trade-offs while maintaining alignment across a complex, partnership-based environment.

• Build strong relationships with AAP stakeholders, RQI-P, customers, and internal teams to gather feedback and guide product decisions.

• Communicate product direction, progress, performance, risks, and trade-offs to stakeholders and senior leadership.

• Serve as a product subject-matter expert, providing guidance and support to commercial, customer support, and other teams.

Who we're looking for

You bring people together around a shared goal and are comfortable working in an environment where success depends on collaboration, influence, and strong relationships. You can move between long-term product thinking and the practical work required to advance priorities, solve problems, and deliver results.

Most importantly, you are motivated by creating meaningful value for learners, instructors, customers, partners, and the patients they serve.

We think you will thrive in this role if you bring:

• A bachelor’s degree in business, product management, healthcare, education, or a related field.

• At least 3 years of experience in product management, program management, portfolio management, or a related role.

• Strong product management, business acumen, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.

• The ability to translate customer, partner, and business needs into clear priorities and outcomes.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• The ability to influence decisions and build alignment in complex, matrixed, or partnership-based environments.

• Willingness and ability to travel as needed, including internationally.

Experience in healthcare, clinical education, digital learning, neonatal or pediatric education, resuscitation, or AAP programs is highly valuable.

Key competencies

• Product thinking and customer focus: You connect insights to clear priorities and valuable solutions.

• Critical thinking and problem solving: You analyze complexity, evaluate trade-offs, and make sound decisions.

• Influencing and alignment: You create momentum without relying on formal authority.

• Communication: You communicate product direction, decisions, and risks clearly with varied audiences.

• Collaboration: You build trusted partnerships across functions, organizations, and geographies.

• Execution and adaptability: You bring structure to ambiguity and keep work moving in a dynamic environment.

Why join Laerdal Copenhagen?

Join a mission-driven team where your work helps improve healthcare and save lives around the world. You'll enjoy a high-trust, low-bureaucracy environment that values autonomy, collaboration, craftsmanship, and continuous learning. Our Copenhagen office, located in a historic warehouse in the city center, combines an ambitious, international culture with a relaxed atmosphere, great colleagues, and flexible working conditions. We are currently counting 160 colleagues in Copenhagen – a mix of talents across product, engineering, design, learning- and medical specialists, working in cross functional teams. As part of Laerdal Medical, you'll work locally with a talented team while being connected to a global organization of 2,600+ people dedicated to helping save one million more lives, every year, by 2030.

GET A FEELING…

…of who we are in Laerdal Copenhagen in this video.

…and see more about our mission and shared goal.

Interested?

Please register your application by December 9 2026. Apply with your CV and a short motivation explaining why this role speaks to you.

Only applications with both parts will be reviewed. Beware that LinkedIn only allows one document upload, so merge them into one, before you hit the APPLY button.

If you have any questions that might keep you from applying, please contact Alison Lassen, Portfolio Director, at Alison.Lassen@Laerdal.com.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About the Role

We're seeking a driven Business Intelligence Analyst to join our FP&A team, reporting to our FP&A Data Lead - someone early in their data career who's eager to help build our new data platform and grow with it, in a high-impact role that offers real visibility and room to grow.

Now a delisted, growth-equity backed business, OrderYOYO is entering an exciting new chapter – a clear testament to our bold growth ambitions and the fast paced, high-impact environment we are building.

We're building a new data platform that brings together data from every restaurant partner, both on our own platform and on the platforms we acquire. Our Data team builds the pipelines, warehouse and core models; this role sits between them and the people who use the data, turning what lands in the warehouse into something the business can actually work with.

In this role, you'll gain broad exposure across the business by collaborating with Management, Finance, Commercial teams, Tech and Product Owners. You'll play a key role in turning data into actionable insights, including translating business questions into something measurable, modelling the right data, building the reporting and presenting findings for key stakeholders. As you grow, you'll have the freedom to shape your path based on your strengths and interests.

Here's a taste of what you'll be doing:

• Get to know our data warehouse in depth - what data we have, where it comes from and what it can be trusted for - and help scope and integrate data from the companies we acquire.

• Model data into analysis-ready datasets, so the rest of the FP&A team can find and use the right data without starting from raw data every time.

• Write SQL to pull and shape data for Management, Finance, Commercial and Data Science.

• Build and maintain reporting in Power BI - dashboards, recurring management reports and KPI scorecards - and keep the metric definitions behind them consistent, so the business has one version of each number.

• Check data quality, reconcile figures that don't match across sources, and explain why a number moved.

• Turn stakeholder questions into measurable analysis, such as why a new market is ramping up slower than expected or which partners are at risk of churning, and turn recurring requests into reusable models or reports.

What We Are Looking For In You:

• A degree in a quantitative or data-related field, such as economics, statistics, engineering, computer science or information systems.

• Solid SQL skills you have used in practice - in a job, a project or your studies.

• Some understanding of data modelling (how tables, keys and dimensions fit together), or a clear wish to learn it.

• Experience with, or a strong interest in, a BI tool such as Power BI, Tableau or Looker.

• Strong business sense. Curious about which numbers matter and why the business wants them.

• Structured and careful. You check your own numbers before someone else has to.

• A team player who enjoys helping colleagues get to the data they need, with strong communication in English (Danish is a plus but not a requirement).

Why Join Us?

• Help build a modern data platform early in your career, while it is still taking shape, with data that Management uses to make decisions from day one.

• A clear growth path - from learning the platform and supporting the team, to owning metric definitions and how we report.

• Work in a supportive, team-first culture where we help each other succeed.

• Expect personal development plans and ongoing training tailored to your growth.

• Be part of a high-growth journey in a growth equity-backed company, where ambition meets opportunity - and your impact truly matters.

Great to Have (But Not Required)

• Understanding of database structures and data modelling, such as star schemas and semantic models.

• Understanding of how SQL is used to query, model and transform data.

• Hands-on experience with Power BI, including DAX and Power Query.

• Familiarity with finance or commercial concepts, such as cohort modelling.

What we do at OrderYOYO

OrderYOYO is a provider of white-label online ordering, payment, marketing, and POS software solutions to independent local takeaway restaurants. We are ensuring that small to medium-sized restaurants and chains are not subjected to lofty commissions and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success.

Who we are at OrderYOYO

Company culture is at the forefront of our minds creating an enjoyable, safe working environment where employee personal expression is supported. We are one team here at OrderYOYO and strive to help others succeed. Personal development and training plans are a key part of your journey within OrderYOYO, helping you be the best you can be by providing consistent and ongoing training for all aspects of the business. Our values (Passion, Action, Compassion, One team) are what makes us who we are and will be embedded in your day-to-day no matter what area of the business you work in.

We are looking for an engineer who wants to build the foundation of our new Integrations effort: the connectors that bring our customers' data from third-party systems into the Trackunit platform. The connectors you build directly support our new partnership business, one of our key goals for next year. You will be among the first developers on this project, designing a reusable architecture and working directly with the engineers behind the systems we connect to, as well as seeing customer feedback shape what you build next. You might have a couple of years or be an experienced senior engineer, either way, we would be interested in seeing your application for this role.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Shape how the work gets done. Join a new, small team set up next to an established platform team, and help define how integrations get built here.

• Hear directly from the people using what you build. Customer feedback feeds straight back into the roadmap, and we act on it quickly.

• Collaborate beyond your own codebase. You’ll have regular, technically focused conversations with developers from the systems we connect to.

• Learn from experts who share. You’ll work with experienced domain experts who are open to sharing what they know, so you learn quickly.

• See your work ship. We favour small, frequent releases over long project cycles, so progress is visible fast.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend developer with strong Java skills, just as comfortable at the edges where systems meet as inside your own codebase.

• Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and REST APIs, in particular consuming data from other systems, in a microservice architecture.

• Experience designing new, reliable, reusable architecture for integrating with multiple systems. System-to-system integration experience is what we value most.

• You are comfortable discussing technical feasibility and approaches with third-party technical teams.

• You care what happens when data moves between systems, so you build with quality, observability and reliability in mind and you know quickly when something breaks.

• You are motivated by incremental delivery, enjoy getting close to the data, and like building new foundations from scratch.

You embrace AI as part of how you engineer. From prototyping through to production, you use AI tools as an integrated part of your workflow, not as a shortcut but as a force multiplier. That said, this isn't the main thing we're hiring for: curiosity and a willingness to use it well matter more than deep prior experience.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Design a reusable architecture for integrating with multiple third-party systems, not one-off solutions.

• Build connectors that collect data from third-party systems, usually ERPs, mainly by consuming their REST APIs, and bring it reliably into our platform.

• Understand the data you collect and transform it into Trackunit's data model.

• Work with third-party vendors: discuss technical feasibility and approaches with their technical counterparts.

• Build with quality, observability and reliability in mind, on our microservice and event-driven architecture.

****Our hiring process

****Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a lead engineer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

**Automation Engineer – VELUX A/S - Thyregod

****Step into a key role where you will help shape the future of manufacturing through automation, robotics, and smart production technologies. With your technical expertise and passion for creating reliable production solutions, you could be our next Automation Engineer in Thyregod.

****Meet your future team

**You will become part of the Project Engineering team in Thyregod, working closely with colleagues across engineering, production, maintenance, and external suppliers. The team is responsible for developing, implementing, and maturing production technologies that support efficient, stable, and safe manufacturing operations.

As our automation specialist, you will play a central role in automation-related projects and production development initiatives. You will work in an environment characterized by collaboration, knowledge sharing, mutual respect, and a strong commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.

**What We Offer

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence both new projects and the continuous development of our production facilities. You will apply your technical expertise while collaborating with colleagues from different disciplines and helping to bring innovative solutions into operation.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Act as the automation specialist in engineering projects and production development activities.

• Provide technical guidance and support to automation technicians, maintenance teams, and project stakeholders.

• Verify and approve machinery and equipment according to applicable requirements and specifications.

• Support the commissioning, qualification, and maturation of new technologies and production equipment.

• Develop, review, and optimize automation solutions, including programmable logic controller programming and robotic applications.

• Participate in Factory Acceptance Tests and Site Acceptance Tests to ensure successful implementation.

• Contribute to initiatives involving industrial connectivity, manufacturing information technology systems, cloud-based solutions, servers, and standardized machine control concepts where relevant.

• Drive continuous improvements that enhance productivity, quality, safety, and operational stability.

**What You Will Bring

**You combine strong technical capabilities with a practical and structured approach to problem-solving. You enjoy working across disciplines and are motivated by transforming technical requirements into dependable production solutions.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Hold a degree in engineering, automation, electronics, or another relevant technical discipline, or possess equivalent technical qualifications.

• Have around 5-10 years of experience within industrial automation, robotics, or manufacturing technology.

• Bring solid experience in programmable logic controller programming, preferably with Siemens TIA Portal.

• Have experience with robotics; knowledge of KUKA and/or Fanuc is considered an advantage.

• Have participated in commissioning activities, Factory Acceptance Tests, Site Acceptance Tests, and equipment qualification processes.

• Have experience with or interest in industrial connectivity, manufacturing information technology, cloud technologies, servers, and machine control standards.

• Communicate effectively in both Danish and English.

• Enjoy collaborating with diverse stakeholders and building strong working relationships across functions.

The position includes limited domestic and international travel, typically up to 20 days annually. Travel will primarily be within Europe.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect from our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match.

All enquiries will be treated confidentially.

Job Title: AI Upskilling & Adoption Lead (12-month maternity cover)

Department: AI Upskilling & Adoption, IT

Location: Ballerup, Greater Copenhagen, Denmark

As AI Upskilling & Adoption Lead, you will help colleagues and leaders make AI a practical part of their everyday work. In this 12-month maternity cover, you will turn business needs into tailored AI sessions for leadership teams and functional audiences, and carry learning from our global AI events into follow-up and knowledge sharing. You will own defined initiatives and help shape what comes next, so people use AI tools with confidence.

Your new role

**Responsibilities

**You will take ownership of agreed activities within AI enablement and enterprise AI events, while contributing to other priorities across AI Upskilling & Adoption. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Turning stakeholder needs and insights into relevant demonstrations of approved AI tools such as Microsoft 365 Copilot and ChatGPT Enterprise, learning sessions and hands-on exercises.

• Guiding the development of presentations and learning materials, so they are relevant, high quality and consistent with the Enterprise AI narrative and approved guidance.

• Defining success measures and overseeing participant resources, feedback and follow-up, using evidence and lessons learned to improve learning outcomes and future initiatives.

• Developing reusable approaches, documentation and templates, and acting as a specialist resource for colleagues, building relationships that support continuity and knowledge sharing.

• Recommending improvements for future Enterprise AI events and, where assigned, leading planning and delivery across programme, production, communications and local engagement.

• Working independently within agreed priorities, managing plans and dependencies, resolving delivery challenges and escalating risks or decisions that need wider alignment.

Some travel to other Novo Nordisk offices in Denmark may be required for AI upskilling events.

Your new department

You will join AI Upskilling & Adoption within IT at Novo Nordisk, reporting to Tamari Ladbye-Hansen. The team helps colleagues understand the business potential of AI and build the confidence to use approved tools in their everyday work.

Day to day, you will partner with leadership teams, functional audiences, business colleagues, subject-matter experts and delivery partners. You will also work with colleagues across programme, production, communications and local engagement to deliver global AI events. You will align expectations early, keep dependencies visible and speak up when something needs a decision, so work keeps moving.

**Your Skills And Qualifications

**You combine hands-on AI knowledge with strong facilitation and project management skills. You can quickly understand a business audience, make AI relevant to their work and coordinate the people and activities needed to deliver a useful experience.

**We Are Looking For Someone Who Brings

**

• Experience in AI adoption, digital enablement or learning and development, translating business needs into practical learning activities.

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot and ChatGPT Enterprise, including creating skills and guidance materials, testing demonstrations and explaining capabilities and limitations.

• Strong presentation and facilitation skills, with the confidence to engage senior leadership teams, support hands-on exercises and respond to questions.

• Project management experience, including coordinating interconnected workstreams, milestones, dependencies, risks and decisions.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align expectations and work effectively with business colleagues, subject-matter experts and delivery partners.

• Sound judgement when selecting internal information and preparing examples for responsible AI use.

• The ability to own agreed deliverables independently, adapt to changing priorities and contribute across the team.

The following experience would be useful, but is not essential:

• Planning or delivering global, hybrid or broadcast events.

• Designing learning experiences for executive or functional leadership audiences.

• Supporting employee engagement through champion networks and local teams.

• Using participation data, feedback and other measures to improve learning or engagement activities.

• Creating reusable presentations, learning resources, project templates and delivery playbooks.

We welcome different professional backgrounds that bring together AI knowledge, learning, stakeholder engagement and structured delivery.

Working at Novo Nordisk

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. As we continue our digital transformation journey, you'll find exciting opportunities to grow your expertise while working alongside talented colleagues who share your passion for excellence. When you join us, you're not just optimizing processes you're enabling innovations that span generations.

What we offer

At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

You will work at the forefront of AI and technology, as Novo upskills its workforce to advance AI as a driver of innovation for people living with serious chronic diseases. You will be trusted to own your initiatives, make your voice heard and contribute across the team’s priority streams.

You will build new skills through hands-on delivery, work with senior leaders and colleagues across functions, and be supported to perform at your best. Clear expectations help you focus on the outcomes that matter.

Do you have experience configuring, testing and commissioning control systems for high-voltage substations? Would you like to apply your expertise to projects supporting Denmark’s electricity transmission grid? Join COWI as a Substation Control and Automation Specialist.

Develop and commission substation control systems

We are looking for an experienced specialist to work on control and automation systems for Energinet’s 132–400 kV substations. Projects range from new substations to extensions, refurbishment and replacement of systems at existing sites.

You will design, configure, test and commission substation control systems, including remote terminal units (RTUs), bay control units (BCUs) and human–machine interfaces (HMIs). Working closely with other specialists, you will ensure that these systems operate correctly and integrate with the substation’s primary equipment, protection systems and communication infrastructure.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Design and configure substation control and monitoring functions in accordance with functional requirements and customer specifications.

• Configure, test and commission RTUs, bay control units and HMIs.

• Configure and verify communication interfaces between control devices, protection equipment and remote control systems.

• Plan and perform functional and integration testing to verify control functions, signal exchange and correct operation of system interfaces.

• Troubleshoot configuration, communication and interface issues in collaboration with other technical specialists.

• Prepare and maintain configuration documentation, test procedures and test records.

• Coordinate technical interfaces with colleagues responsible for protection, communication systems, electrical design and primary equipment

• Undertake the designated on-site role of “holdleder” when required and subject to the relevant qualifications and authorisation.

Your expertise

You take a systematic approach to configuration, testing and troubleshooting. You work independently, pay close attention to technical detail and collaborate effectively with colleagues, customers and suppliers. You understand how individual devices and interfaces contribute to the operation of the complete substation control system.

You will also bring:

• A relevant qualification in electrical engineering or an equivalent technical background, combined with at least five years of relevant experience with control systems for high-voltage substations.

• Demonstrated experience configuring and testing substation control equipment from multiple manufacturers.

• Practical experience with IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 60870-5-103 and IEC 61850 communication protocols and standards.

• A sound understanding of the interfaces between substation control systems, protection equipment and high-voltage primary equipment.

• Experience with functional testing, system integration and commissioning of substation control systems.

• Professional proficiency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• The ability to obtain the required security clearance and meet the qualification and authorisation requirements for acting as “holdleder” at high-voltage substations.

Your place of work

Depending on project requirements, you may work from one of COWI’s offices in Denmark, at Energinet project locations or partly from home. Testing and commissioning activities will require attendance at the relevant project sites. Travel within Denmark is expected.

A place to work and so much more

**About The Job

**As a Medical Affairs Intern - Neurology, you will gain hands-on experience within the Medical Affairs team of a global pharmaceutical company, contributing to a research project that combines scientific literature reviews with insights from clinical experts.

**As our new Software Engineer, Investment Data Integrations 📈

• Help create an AI-assisted approach to developing and maintaining integrations safely at scale.

• An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced, motivated and independent laboratory technician/laboratory manager to join a newly established research group at the Biotech Research and Innovation Centre (BRIC), University of Copenhagen, investigating the molecular mechanisms of synaptic plasticity.

  We particularly welcome applications from experienced laboratory technicians seeking a long-term role in a research group.

  As the first member of the new research group, you will work closely with the group leader to establish the laboratory from the ground up. The position combines hands-on experimental work with responsibility for laboratory organization and offers the opportunity to play a central role in shaping how the laboratory develops as the group grows. We hope to build a lasting working relationship with a colleague who enjoys taking ownership of laboratory operations and experimental methods.

  Information on the department can be found at: https://www.bric.ku.dk/

   

  Our research

  Our research aims to understand how neuronal connections respond and adapt to activity, with a particular focus on the local molecular mechanisms regulating synaptic function and plasticity. We are particularly interested in how RNA localization and local protein synthesis are spatially organized at synapses, and how these processes contribute to activity-dependent changes in neuronal connectivity.

  We combine molecular and cellular neuroscience with advanced imaging, transcriptomic and proteomic approaches to investigate these questions across different types of synapses, including conventional neuronal synapses and specialized synapses of the retina.

  We are establishing a new research group at BRIC and aim to build an ambitious, collaborative and supportive team with open communication, high scientific standards and shared responsibility. As the first member of the laboratory, you will have a unique opportunity to contribute to its development from the beginning.

   

  Your job

  You will work closely with the group leader during the initial establishment of the laboratory and, as the team expands, become a central technical and organizational point of contact for the group.

  Your tasks will include:

   	
• Helping establish the laboratory, including ordering systems, stocks, equipment, documentation and shared laboratory resources. 	
• Establishing, documenting and maintaining laboratory protocols, procedures and experimental workflows. 	
• Contributing to hands-on experimental work and supporting ongoing research projects. 	
• Implementing, optimizing and troubleshooting new experimental methods. 	
• Onboarding and training new students, postdoctoral researchers and other group members in laboratory procedures and experimental techniques. 	
• Helping ensure continuity in laboratory procedures, experimental workflows and technical knowledge as the group grows. 	
• Coordinating shared laboratory activities and contributing to an efficient, safe and well-organized research environment.   The position is expected to develop together with the research group. Initially, there will be a strong focus on establishing the laboratory and experimental workflows. As the team grows, the role is expected to increasingly combine hands-on research with laboratory coordination, training and technical support.

   

  Profile

  We are looking for a motivated, independent and collaborative colleague who enjoys taking responsibility and contributing to the development of a new research environment. Substantial hands-on laboratory experience, reliability and an interest in long-term technical stewardship are particularly valued; a PhD is not required.

  Essential experience and skills

   	
• Relevant training as a laboratory technician, biomedical laboratory scientist or equivalent, or comparable professional experience in a biomedical research environment. 	
• Demonstrated experience working independently in a biomedical research laboratory and taking responsibility for experimental workflows, laboratory procedures or shared laboratory activities. 	
• Broad practical laboratory experience and the ability to implement and troubleshoot experimental procedures. 	
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and follow tasks through to completion. 	
• Good communication and collaboration skills. 	
• A proactive and solution-oriented approach to laboratory work. 	
• An interest in sharing knowledge and training students and other researchers. 	
• Good written and spoken English.   Desirable experience and skills:

  Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage:

   	
• Laboratory organization or management, including ordering, stocks, equipment or shared laboratory resources. 	
• Establishing, documenting and troubleshooting experimental protocols. 	
• Molecular biology and RNA or protein biochemistry. 	
• Cell culture, including neuronal cell culture. 	
• Microscopy and imaging. 	
• Tissue processing and histological techniques. 	
• Experimental animal models. 	
• Experience working with neural tissue, particularly retinal tissue, would be an advantage   We do not expect you to have experience with all techniques used in the group. Training can be provided for the right person. We particularly value applicants who are interested in taking ownership of their role, developing new skills and growing with the research group while contributing to its long-term development. Applicants with extensive practical laboratory experience are encouraged to apply regardless of publication record.

   

  Place of employment

  The place of employment is at the Biotech Research and Innovation Centre (BRIC), Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. BRIC provides a dynamic and international

  We aim to create a supportive and highly collaborative research environment with open communication, high scientific standards and a strong sense of shared responsibility. The position offers considerable independence and the opportunity to develop a broad and central role as the research group grows.

   

  Terms of employment

  The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

  The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 3 years. The starting date is 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  Employment as laboratory technician will be in accordance with the agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and OAO/HK STAT. The position is placed in salary group 4.

  Employment will be in accordance with the provisions of the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). The monthly salary will be based on the number of years of work experience (seniority) with the possibility to negotiate a salary supplement based on prior experiences and qualifications. The employer will pay an additional 18.07 % to your pension fund.

  Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions, if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

  The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2020.

   

  Questions

  For further information regarding the position, please contact Eva Kaulich, Associate Professor and Group Leader, BRIC, University of Copenhagen: eva.kaulich@bric.ku.dk

   

  Application

  Your application should be submitted in English and include:

   	
• Motivated letter of application (max. one page). 	
• CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position. 	
• Copies of relevant educational or professional qualifications (for example, laboratory technician or biomedical laboratory scientist training certificates); a PhD is not required. 	
• Optional: a brief description of relevant laboratory methods, technical responsibilities or laboratory management experience. Publications are not required.   Please submit your application by clicking on “Apply Now” below. Only online applications will be accepted.

   

  Deadline for applications: 2 December 2026, 23.59pm CET 

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

   

  The further process 

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

   

  Interviews are expected to be held in week 49-50

  The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.
